title: M4: add accounting and computed-report adapters

input.requestedOutcome: Add the M4 frontend adapter for accounting, agent statements, Travel Summary, and Daily Report using the verified operation-backend report contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Operations mode renders server-computed accounting, statement, travel-summary, and daily-report payloads.
Daily report settings use the documented server-first GET/PUT endpoints and only update the in-memory cache after success.
Permission and route failures are visible; legacy mode delegates to the original renderers and persistence.
Trip P&L, cost templates/plans, and P&L close/freeze remain legacy-only.
No backend, database, schema, migration, or mapping changes are made.
constraints: Work only in D:/projects/wt-ops-money-reports on agent/ops-money-reports.
Use laOps/laOpsFetch plumbing and verified route contracts; no direct operation-backend fetch.
Preserve classic script ordering, server-first ops behavior, and legacy fallback.
Do not push or edit operation_backend.
assumptions: 00-ops-core.js provides laOps.get, laOps.call, laOps.queue, invalidation, and ops-mode detection.

output.summary: Added an ops-only M4 adapter that renders server-computed accounting, agent statement, Travel Summary, and Daily Report views, with a server-first Daily Report settings write and unchanged legacy fallback.

filesChanged.purpose: Loads the M4 adapter as a classic script after the legacy app and ops core/adapters, before ops boot.
Loads and renders verified money-report endpoint payloads, wraps report entry points only in ops mode, surfaces errors, and keeps Trip P&L/cost plans unwrapped.
Exercises report endpoint calls, server payload rendering, settings PUT, legacy no-call fallback, credits, and no legacy-blob mutation.
Records M4 scope, contracts, decisions, verification, risks, and rollback.
Provides the coordinator-readable M4 handoff manifest.

behaviorChanges.before: Aggregate KPIs/dashboard values were computed from browser SB_* data.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode loads GET /v1/reports/accounting and replaces the displayed aggregate block with server values while retaining the M1 invoice-table boundary.

behaviorChanges.before: Statement values came from the local invoice/deposit projection.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode loads GET /v1/agents/:id/statement and renders server invoice, deposit, credit, balance, and credit-limit values.

behaviorChanges.before: Report bodies were computed by legacy browser aggregators.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode renders GET /v1/reports/travel-summary?date= and GET /v1/reports/daily?date= payloads, including the server settings snapshot.
Ops mode sends PUT /v1/reports/daily/settings and updates the report cache only after success; report reads/settings do not write the legacy blob.
Wrappers are inert unless laOps is enabled; disabled ops mode delegates to the original functions unchanged.

changed: Ops-mode wrappers for renderAccounting, acctDashboardHtml, acctStatementOpen, renderTravelSum, renderDailyReport, and drCfgSet

details: Computed reports are read-only and are not written to localStorage or the legacy blob in ops mode.
Daily report settings are the only M4 write and go through PUT /v1/reports/daily/settings before the in-memory cache is changed.
No backend, schema, migration, mapping, or database files were changed.

verification.evidence: 10 focused assertions passed, including endpoint use, server rendering, credits, settings, legacy no-call behavior, and unchanged loveandaman_v2 blob.
Existing unrelated ops scenarios failed for boat catalogue, route calendar, lock edit/release, and booking pickup; the suite aborted before any M4-specific assertion.

verification.command: rg scan of the M4 adapter/test for bkV2, direct fetch, and Trip P&L/cost-plan identifiers
verification.evidence: No forbidden bkV2 or direct fetch matches; Trip P&L/cost-plan text is explanatory exclusion only and no such entry point is wrapped.

decisions: Keep the legacy invoice table renderer as the M1 integration boundary while replacing the accounting aggregate/dashboard block with the authoritative server report.
Render server statement credits in addition to invoices and deposits.
Cache computed reads by report/date, invalidate them after an ops write, and only update Daily Report settings after a successful PUT response.
Do not add any Trip P&L, cost-template, cost-plan, or close/freeze endpoint because the M4 packet marks those areas unmigrated.
risks: The broader npm run test:ops suite has unrelated baseline failures in this worktree.
Accounting invoice list hydration and invoice mutations remain M1-owned; M4 intentionally does not invent an invoice endpoint or local approximation.
Report caches are invalidated after laOps writes but are otherwise retained for the current page/date until refreshed.
blockers: npm run test:ops remains red for pre-existing boat/calendar/lock/booking scenarios; focused M4 and backend money-report tests pass.
dependencies: P0 laOps auth/core and authenticated operations-mode detection
M1 server invoice projection for the accounting table
followUps: Run the focused adapter test against an authenticated deployed operation-backend instance.
Integrate M1's authoritative invoice projection when the M1 packet lands.
rollback: Revert local implementation commit a0073b8 or remove the M4 script tag and adapter; no database rollback is needed.
